svg.title: ShadowsLunarfox/Server-Check-Status
svg.desc: Server Check Status is a lightweight Python desktop tool for checking whether a single server accepts TCP connections on a selected port. The tool is designed for simple availability checks: enter a server IP address or domain name, choose a port, set the number of attempts, and click Start. Python; 25 stars; 5 forks.

g.font-family: Segoe UI, Noto Sans, Arial, sans-serif
